title: Determine whether the score meets the standard
goal: Compares the test score and the current standard line to handle the situation where the standard is just met.
summary: The result of the comparison operation is true or false. > means strictly greater than, >= includes equality.
tasks: Compares score and minimumScore within the curly braces of meetsScore. Both parameters are numerical values.
Return true if the score reaches or exceeds the threshold, otherwise return false. Return the comparison result directly.
hint: Think of a situation where the score is exactly equal to the mark. The operator used must contain the equal sign.

example.note: There are four boxes of items in the warehouse, which are lower than the replenishment line of five boxes. The comparison result is true.
